items.claim: Islam secures takedowns after getting in close.
items.quote: After he gets in close, I think he secures the takedown.

items.claim: Ian Garry's grappling will not be able to handle Islam Makhachev.
items.quote: I know Ian's grappling is top tier, but I just don't think he can handle Islam.

items.claim: Islam Makhachev is exceptionally good at timing his takedowns.
items.quote: He's too good at timing the takedowns.

items.claim: Once Islam Makhachev gets an opponent down, they are not going to get up.
items.quote: And if he gets you down, you're you're not going to get up.

items.claim: Ian Garry has great defensive striking for avoiding wrestling.
items.quote: the defensive striking of Ian is is great for avoiding wrestling

items.claim: Ian Garry has developed a lot, especially on the grappling side.
items.quote: He's always been a great striker, but he has developed his grappling

items.claim: Islam Makhachev has almost no flaws in his game.
items.quote: I don't see many flaws, you know, I I I almost no no flaw in his game
